note: Random rolls an item gets when it drops. None of this is published on
rtm-database.pages.dev -- the tooltips there show the item as designed,
not as dropped.
The tables come from the server's own files (returntomorroc/, a 2023-12
snapshot of RTM's rAthena fork) through crawler/import_server_rolls.py:
item_randomopt_group.yml for what each group rolls, item_randomopt_db.yml
for what each option does (RTM reuses upstream option names for its own
effects, so the script decides), mob_db.yml for which group each dropped
item rolls ('items', item id -> table). Where the live game has been seen
to differ from the 2023 files the hand roll is kept (KEEP_HAND in the
importer: the garment leech roll). Items the server does not know fall
back to the slot and type rules below.
A roll is a choice from a list plus a value the player reads off their
own item, so the ranges here only bound the input. Where a range is not
known, 'max' is null and the UI leaves the upper bound open rather than
inventing one.
Slots with no table (costume) are not a statement that they roll
nothing -- only that nobody has described them yet. Add a table here and
it appears in the planner.
'requires' gates a table on the item rather than the slot. Headgear and
accessories roll only when the item is a monster drop, which the crawled
drop lists already answer. 'types' lists item types a table is for: it
shares the slot with the slot's ordinary table and comes first for those
items -- a Dracomancer orb rolls its own two, not the rune's.
A skill grant with 'skill_name' always names that skill, so the player
is not asked for it; 'metric' says what it raises ('level', or 'damage').
'requires' on a roll gates that one roll on the item: 'says' lists phrases,
any of which the item's description must contain (case aside). Normal gear
rolls a skill modifier only when it says so -- Vesper Cores, Kafra Ring,
Sombrero, Death Hand, Honor of the Fallen, Temporal Manteau.
'never_from' names places whose gear never rolls, whatever its slot's
table says: matched against where the item is got (the crawl's vendor
or exchange line), case aside. From the project owner, 2026-09-25: Sky
Garden equipment cannot roll random options.
